rules.source_quote: This protocol applies to international business travel and selected elevated-risk domestic travel.
High-tier travel requires VP approval, Risk briefing, International SOS confirmation, and itinerary submission.
Extreme-tier travel is generally prohibited and requires CFO and General Counsel approval with documented business necessity.
International travelers are enrolled in International SOS based on Concur bookings.
Required visas and immunizations should be obtained in advance; maintain passport and itinerary documentation.
High-tier destinations require vetted lodging and pre-arranged vetted ground transportation.
For medical/security incidents, contact International SOS promptly and notify Risk Management.
Travel to countries under U.S. economic sanctions is prohibited absent an OFAC license.
Use VPN for all internet access while abroad.
Travelers should assume border device inspection and avoid carrying sensitive data.
After high-tier travel, debrief with Risk Management within 5 business days.
If symptoms develop within 14 days of return from advisory destinations, notify HR before office return.
